answers.question: Is rain associated with lower PM10 in Mumbai?

final.answer: Using measured PM10 (µg/m³) and modelled weather for Mumbai across all data (default period: 2025-02-18..2026-10-30), days with more rainfall tended to have lower PM10 (strong association, Spearman rho = -0.73, 526 days). This is an association, not a cause.
final.explanation: Measured PM + modelled weather: PM10 and rainfall in Mumbai, 2025-02-18 to 2026-10-30. 22 primary stations (primary). 526 matched days. Method: Spearman rank correlation between daily city PM and the daily weather value; days grouped into quartiles (or dry/rain) to show average PM per group.

answers.question: Were there any unusual PM2.5 days in Delhi in 2025?

final.answer: Using measured PM2.5 (µg/m³) for Delhi in 2025, there were 27 unusual days identified out of 296 days tested (20 high, 7 low) using a 15-day rolling median method. For example, 2025-12-14 was unusually high at 384.5 µg/m³ compared to a median of 202.3 µg/m³, while 2025-11-05 was unusually low at 104.4 µg/m³ compared to a median of 212.8 µg/m³.
final.explanation: Measured PM: Unusual PM2.5 days in Delhi, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. 37 primary stations (primary reference). 296 of 365 days have a city value. Method: Each day's city value is compared with the median of the 15 surrounding days (the day itself excluded).
